values.meaning: Vine Lasher duration when a Seed sprouts
values.quote: sprouts into a ... ''Vine Lasher'' that lasts for 8 seconds.
values.binNote: No matching data value in ZyraE; the 8s Vine Lasher lifespan is likely governed by a plant-entity field (e.g. ZyraP.PlantDuration=8) outside this slot's sheet excerpt, so left unbound.

values.meaning: Locked out of actions after casting
values.quote: '''Zyra''' will be locked out of actions for {{fd|0.15}} seconds after casting ''Grasping Roots''.
values.binNote: Not present among the listed ZyraE data values; likely a generic post-cast lockout field not included in this excerpt.

mechanics.claim: Grasping Roots deals magic damage to enemies hit and roots them for a duration.
mechanics.quote: shoots a surge of vines in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|root|roots}} them for a duration.

mechanics.claim: If the missile hits a Seed, it sprouts into a Vine Lasher pet.
mechanics.quote: If ''Grasping Roots'' hits a ''Seed'', it sprouts into a [[File:Zyra Grasping Roots Render.png|20px|link=Zyra#Pets]] ''[[Zyra#Pets|Vine Lasher]]'' that lasts for 8 seconds.

mechanics.claim: The ability can be blocked by spell shields.
Each Vine Lasher generates Conqueror and Electrocute stacks, which affects damage output.
mechanics.quote: Each [[File:Zyra Grasping Roots Render.png|20px|link=Zyra#Pets]] ''[[Zyra#Pets|Vine Lasher]]'' will generate 2 stacks of {{ri|Conqueror}} and 1 stack of {{ri|Electrocute}}.
